To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have demonstrated that the Q of superconducting Nb can be raised to the level of the best copper cavities and that we can operate these cavities at fields as high as those used on copper cavities.
Superconducting Nb cavaties with peak surface electric fields up to 16 MV/m and Q values as high as 3.5 x 109 have been achieved in the 1300 MHz range.
we have measured unloaded Q's of 4 × 10 ^{9} at a surface electric field of 16 MV/m on a Nb prototype cavity.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of high-Q superconducting niobium structures for use as microwave cavities.
the development of high-Q niobium superconducting cavities for use in a high-energy electron-positron collider.
the development of superconducting radio frequency (rf) cavities for the next generation of particle accelerators.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the results obtained on the Nb prototype structures are quite promising.
the superconducting niobium prototype cavities have demonstrated the feasibility of achieving the required performance for the 1300-MHz superconducting linac.
the Nb cavities have performed very well.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Nb cavities are a viable technology for future superconducting accelerators.
